product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps mid-market businesses collect customer feedback across channels and use AI to identify insights and take action to improve customer experience.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly identified as customers in AWS's SurveySparrow case study.

employee_band.notes: Company size reported on its LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Qualifying posts cover SLOs and Terraform-based reliability tooling, and SurveySparrow's Aurora PostgreSQL migration from version 12 to 16.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation and a help center with numerous integration articles are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public careers board lists openings, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude Sonnet via Amazon Bedrock
model_provider.notes: The DPA names OpenAI and Azure OpenAI; the AWS case study identifies Claude Sonnet for summarization, clustering and sentiment scoring.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly listed compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks rather than standalone certifications.

last_funding.notes: Seed funding from Prime Venture Partners; the funding profile updated November 4, 2026 lists this as its latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: Its latest listed round was in April 2019, before the window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative - US posting has an active application option.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced SparrowCRM on September 3, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Vipin Thomas's profile lists his SurveySparrow VP Revenue Operations & Strategy role ending in June 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting names these as examples of relevant CRM and outbound-sales tools; this is a hiring signal, not confirmation that every system is deployed.
